title: Room guidance: community pool (card 7). Pool, 21 Nov 2026
weak: Two cities, two rule sets: Edmonton uses NBC 2023 (Alberta Edition) Part 7 for pools; Vancouver has no Part 7, so the BC Pool Regulation and BC Guidelines 2025 apply, and several Part 7 items are tool extensions there. Each line says which.
Room minimums from the definition (change rooms, gym) are design values set for the project, not outside sources. They are marked "definition".

(likely) Scaling from the layout's floor areas needs the bather load, which needs the water area. Generator zone layouts hold the pool hall at about 354 m² (25 x 8.5 m tank with decks), so the bather-driven counts below are near-constant across layouts; the gym-driven ones scale with gym floor.
